g.title: run_loop
g.text: While stopped with a window, no instruction runs, but the passes go on: the window is still polled, so Ctrl-X can continue.
The hooks (blue) are where Tiling and StackTracking listen; Emulator.attach() puts their after_* methods into these lists.

g.title: cluster_window
g.text: WINDOW_POLL_INTERVAL; the other passes skip this

g.title: trap
g.text: RWTS hook: True = served, go on

g.title: stopped
g.text: (and until is dropped, so it won't stop again)

g.title: throttle
g.text: sleep to the Apple II's pace

g.title: op
g.text: the operation, with its addressing mode

g.title: op->kinds
g.text: each byte it reads or writes
